text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training, Yamanin Zephyr suffered an injury,
so I hurried to bring her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry,
I got swept off my feet by a whirlwind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
However, if I just shrink back,
I will only be swallowed by the wind...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let's return to training.
The wind always blows back stronger.
choice_data_list: Let's bounce back after that injury heals.
Let's bounce back after that injury heals.
If you're that insistent, let's do it together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let's return to training.
The wind always blows back stronger.
choice_data_list: Let's bounce back after that injury heals.
Let's bounce back after that injury heals.
If you're that insistent, let's do it together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: However, I can't heal an injury right this second...
choice_data_list: So let's hold off on training.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
I can't cause you any more trouble.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
For the time being, I will focus on letting my injury heal.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I will definitely
come blowing back even stronger than before...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that, Yamanin Zephyr rested her body, looking deeply disappointed...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
! ...Thank you very much.
I will make sure to whip up an even stronger wind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I returned to the training course
with Yamanin Zephyr, but...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: U-Uuu... I have to become the wind...
choice_data_list: Let's take a rest today after all.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...I apologize.
I completely misjudged my own condition..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: So said Yamanin Zephyr, nursing her injury and looking visibly downhearted.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It may not be like a swift gale...
but I'm feeling great.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I understand.
Please, do not worry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr continued training at a reasonable pace.
